novelty_flags.label: Theorem 2 / related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: The related-work discussion omits Chen and Gao's public 2026 preprint on minimax learning of submanifold integrals, the closest thin-set minimax and inference comparator; it must be distinguished explicitly from a pointwise boundary-trace sup-risk result.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 1, pervasive KL formula
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed general KL coefficient does not reduce to its claimed kappa=3 value: C_alpha=1/3 at alpha=1 makes the displayed coefficient 1/144, whereas the stated special case is 1/480; the squared-tent integral is not the half-ball mass coefficient.

soundness_flags.label: Causal interpretation throughout
soundness_flags.one_line: The only defined target is an observed-regression trace contrast; no potential-outcome, consistency, or cross-boundary continuity assumption identifies it with the repeatedly claimed causal boundary treatment-effect curve.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies random designs with a finite number of well-separated density zeros and derives global L2 minimax bounds and adaptive wavelet estimators.
The paper develops pointwise and uniform estimation and inference for a conditional treatment-effect function along a bivariate assignment boundary.
The distance-based minimax result assumes a continuous score density bounded above and bounded away from zero.
The paper gives minimax rates and inference for regression functionals integrated over submanifolds, establishing a close but non-subsuming thin-set comparator.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Recompute the pervasive and isolated KL constants from the squared-tent integrals, replace the erroneous mass-coefficient substitution, and retain explicit alpha=1 checks before using these experiments in every converse.

Either introduce potential outcomes, consistency, and side-specific continuity assumptions that identify the trace as a causal BATEC, or consistently relabel the project as observed regression-trace inference.

Add Chen--Gao as the closest thin-set comparator and state precisely why submanifold integrals, rather than pointwise curve estimation under sparse random design, do not settle the proposed isolated-versus-pervasive frontier.

recommended_next_step: Reject this version and return it for a formula-corrected witness theorem plus a resolved causal estimand; then re-review the repaired field-tier minimax kernel.
